chunks: Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: I heard him say:
ʿAlī عليه السلام inherited from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله his knowledge, and Fāṭimah عليها السلام inherited his estate.

key_terms.تَرِكَتَهُ: his estate or material legacy left behind
key_terms.عِلْمَهُ: his knowledge, referring to the Prophet’s transmitted knowledge

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and Sayyidah Fāṭimah عليها السلام inherit from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith distinguishes between two kinds of inheritance from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله: knowledge, inherited by ʿAlī عليه السلام, and material estate, inherited by Fāṭimah عليها السلام. It highlights both the special transmission of prophetic knowledge and the recognition of familial inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5605 - Jamil bin Darraj narrated from Zurara, who reported from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that he said:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) inherited the knowledge of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family), and Sayyida Fatimah {s.a} (peace be upon her) inherited his possessions."
